question: Does a broader eight-target training panel and averaging two SPSA directions improve own-state validation compared with the E115 parent?
parent: Pinned latest completed qualifying E115; preserve hashes and recursive dependencies. Fresh optimizer seed1170, not continuation of E116 rejected updates or optimizer state.
method: One proposal pilot: fixed seeded eight-target train-only panel with one eligible fine-group and seven coarse-group targets, >=5 measured pairs each. Simulate all302neurons. Two independent antithetic SPSA directions (four candidate models) from each candidate's own60s-settled quarter-phase states; average gradients; Adam first-step lr0.0005, perturbation0.005. Local AND cumulative original0.1 bounds and all fixed-field rules preserved. Both middle/finest replay screens; compare proposal against actual current same-panel replay. No train-test label mixing.
budget: 120min TOTAL inclusive: coordinator110min, final10min saved-data audit/cleanup reserve. Two persistent A100 workers, expensive replay tasks first. Always explicit incomplete/no-qualification on timeout; no broad claim everything will succeed.
validation: Reuse unchanged parent qualified artifacts with input hashes/source/runtime identity verified; reproduce parent training panel on freshly generated own anchors. Full135-target three-grid/four-phase validation is executed once on proposed weights, serving both candidate selection and final numerical evidence. Independently regenerate candidate own anchors during60s/40s two-grid autonomy assay; require state equality and finest panel response replay within1e-10. This independently repeats panel, not full atlas loss. Report this limit explicitly; no false independent full-loss reproduction claim. Preserve original vector/mixed/control/rhythm/parameter gates; parent RMD comparison uses verified saved E115 own-state autonomy traces.
selection: Choose candidate only with improved same-panel training score, raw and regularized own-state validation improvement, all full numerical/control gates, fixed/cumulative parameters, autonomy preservation, state and panel replay reproduction and complete audit. Otherwise retain E115; no test-score-based selection. Evaluate test after decision and disclose historical reuse.
artifacts: All five trial models, perturbation directions/gradient/Adam/RNG state, anchors, compact replay matrices, exact source/env/argv, every task and selection evidence external. Independent saved-data audit recomputes scores, selection, averaged gradient and parameter projection. No body/swimming/sensory-start-stop qualification.
